chapter_note: Chapter contains a clear substrate mythic enumeration: Matter/envy envies (1) First Man, (2) the Ambassador's icon, (3) Adam, (4) the firstborn ones / Christ / wood of the cross / Righteousness. This four-fold envy enumeration is the cosmological core. The editorial extension layer adds (5) Mani the Apostle, (6) the church and (7) the catechumens — replicating the mythic syntax to apply it to the editor's present. Substrate definition resurfaces in i=55-56 (Matter = enthumesis of Death). The chapter closes with extensive hortatory exhortation to the 'wise man.' Heavy damage in mid-chapter (~68%). Editorial fatigue is mild; ecclesial vocabulary clusters in expected pastoral application section. Seam at i=58 ('until today... up to this Church').
